name: Never Wrong and Always Right Phasorq

description.value: If you're going to be up all night, you might as well read, and if you're reading, you might as well learn, and if you're going to learn something, you should never be truly wrong about it. You gain the Additional Lore skill feat. If you critically fail a @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.Recall Knowledge] check for any Lore skill for which you've taken Additional Lore, you get a failure instead.

publication.title: Starfinder Secrets of the Swarm Adventure Path
